fields.title: 99.co record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of 99.co's own field shape. Indonesian records pass the site's JSON through essentially verbatim, so they keep its snake_case names (full_address, location_pin, price.price_tag); Singapore records are assembled from schema.org plus the React flight payload and use the schema.org names. Record types: idListing, idListingDetail, idLocation, sgListing, sgListingDetail, sgHdbMedianPrice and error. 99.co ships changes without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The search target, slug or URL this record came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction layer produced the row: S1-id-nextdata (Indonesian __NEXT_DATA__), S1-sg-jsonld-rsc (Singapore schema.org + React flight), S1-sg-api (the open JSON API), or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: idListing, idListingDetail, idLocation, sgListing, sgListingDetail, sgHdbMedianPrice or error.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: challenge_wall (Cloudflare served a managed challenge to every TLS profile - on Indonesian search this is the page-10 ceiling and is expected), not_found, no_results, fetch_failed, unexpected_shape, unparsable_input, run_failed.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker. rsc_listing_not_matched means the schema.org spine had no matching flight object, so the row carries identity but not the rich fields; jsonld_itemlist_missing means the reverse.

groupType.title: Group type
groupType.description: Indonesian listings only: 'secondary' for an ordinary listing, 'primary' for a paid developer or project placement. Result pages interleave the two, so filter on this before counting a market.

title.title: Title
title.description: Listing title as the advertiser wrote it.

full_address.title: Full address
full_address.description: Free-text address as entered by the advertiser.

price.title: Price
price.description: Indonesian price object. Carries more than the asking figure: price/price_tag is current, last_price and last_price_change_at record the previous asking price and when it moved, delta_price_percentage the change, and market_price 99.co's own valuation for comparison.

mortgage.title: Mortgage
mortgage.description: Indicative monthly instalments by term, as 99.co computes them.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Structured property attributes (land and building area, bedrooms, bathrooms, floors, certification, furnishing).

location.title: Location
location.description: Administrative hierarchy - province, city, district, subdistrict.

media.title: Media
media.description: Photos, floor plans and video attached to the listing.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Listing agent and agency as 99.co publishes them on the public page.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Listing badges: verified, owner-listed, premium, video viewing and similar.

url.title: URL slug
url.description: Indonesian listing slug. Prepend https://www.99.co/id/properti/ for the page, or feed it straight into idListingDetail.

timestamps.title: Timestamps
timestamps.description: Created, updated and published times for the listing.

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.description: Project or cluster the unit belongs to, when it is part of one.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Developer behind the project, for primary listings.

poiData.title: POI data
poiData.description: Detail pages only: the expanded nearby-amenities dataset.

questionsAndAnswers.title: Questions and answers
questionsAndAnswers.description: Detail pages only: the public Q&A thread on the listing.

priceInsightTrendMarket.title: Price trend
priceInsightTrendMarket.description: Detail pages only: 99.co's market price trend series for the area.

venueData.title: Venue data
venueData.description: Detail pages only: venue and building information.

urlSlug.title: Location URL slug
urlSlug.description: idLocation rows: the search path for this location, ready to paste into idSearchTargets. This is the intended way to split a query that would otherwise hit the 9-page ceiling.

parentSlug.title: Parent location slug
parentSlug.description: idLocation rows: the parent location's slug, or null for a top-level location.

listingId.title: Listing ID
listingId.description: Singapore listing id, taken from the schema.org sku or the final token of the listing URL.

listingUrl.title: Listing URL
listingUrl.description: Canonical Singapore listing URL. Feed into sgListingDetail for the full record.

address.title: Address
address.description: Singapore address. A string on search rows, a schema.org PostalAddress object on detail rows.

propertyTypeLabel.title: Property type
propertyTypeLabel.description: Singapore property type as displayed, e.g. 'HDB 3 Rooms'.

listing.title: Listing payload
listing.description: Singapore search rows: the raw listing object from the React flight payload - price, psf, beds, bathrooms, floor area, tenure, furnishing, coordinates, neighbourhood and region. Nested pointer values are resolved before the record is emitted.

name.title: Name
name.description: Singapore detail rows: listing headline from schema.org.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Singapore detail rows: primary listing image.

floorSize.title: Floor size
floorSize.description: Singapore detail rows: schema.org QuantitativeValue, typically square feet (unitCode FTK).

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Singapore detail rows: schema.org Offer with price and currency.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Singapore detail rows: latitude from schema.org geo.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Singapore detail rows: longitude from schema.org geo.

attributes_sg.title: Attributes (Singapore)
attributes_sg.description: Reserved. Singapore detail attributes are emitted under 'attributes' as a flattened name/value map alongside the raw additionalProperty list.

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: Singapore detail rows: when the page was first published.

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: Singapore detail rows: when the page last changed.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: sgHdbMedianPrice rows: the table's column titles, kept alongside the values so a new flat-type column widens the record instead of shifting every figure.

values.title: Values
values.description: sgHdbMedianPrice rows: the raw row cells, positionally matching columns. An asterisk on a figure is 99.co's own marker, passed through untouched.

pageNumber.title: Page number
pageNumber.description: Which result page this record came from.

pageUrl.title: Page URL
pageUrl.description: The URL actually fetched, after any redirect.

totalCount.title: Total matching listings
totalCount.description: How many listings 99.co says match this query. For Indonesian search this is usually far larger than what one run can reach, because anonymous paging stops at page 9 - the gap is real inventory, not an error.

totalPagesReported.title: Reported page count
totalPagesReported.description: Indonesian search only: the total_page figure 99.co reports (it caps at 500). Recorded for reference; the reachable limit is 9.
